landing.headline: Know how far you are from your prop firm's red line — every day
landing.sub: An MT4 / MT5 trading journal: real P&L after commission and swap, the sessions where you lose, and red lines estimated from your prop firm's rules.
landing.point1: Red lines from each firm's published rules
landing.point1b: FTMO and other firms calculate limits differently. We model each one from its official rules and show the source.
landing.point2: Real P&L after commission and swap
landing.point2b: See how much costs eat into your profit, and which symbols and sessions lose money.
landing.point3b: One message every morning: what you made yesterday and how much room you have today.
